Netlify

Publish web experiences with a reviewable delivery workflow.

NOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Netlify supports website delivery, deployment workflows, and server-side capabilities such as functions. We can use it for a service website, content-led campaign experience, or supported web application. The project combines clear build settings, domain configuration, and deliberate handling of enquiry data so the published experience can be maintained and reviewed as the business changes.

Useful outputs

  • Production website and deploy workflow
  • Configured functions or form handling where scoped
  • Publication and maintenance instructions

Where we can apply it

  • Campaign launch: approved content → preview → custom-domain publication.
  • Lead capture: validated form → function or form handler → approved CRM route.
  • Website maintenance: source change → automated build → reviewed release.
01

Use case 1

Publish static or supported framework websites from versioned source.

02

Use case 2

Add suitable server-side logic for forms, integrations, or lightweight APIs.

03

Use case 3

Review deploy previews before releasing updated pages or campaign content.

Inputs we need

  • Website source and build output configuration
  • Domain access and backend requirements
  • Enquiry routing and environment settings

Delivery sequence

  • Set the build command, output directory, and route behavior.
  • Configure the required form or function logic and secrets.
  • Review previews, verify forms and routes, and connect the domain.

Expert review points

  • Confirm enquiry data reaches the intended authorized destination.
  • Check route handling and server-side limits for the actual framework.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.
